paused.title: Demo paused
paused.body: The Q&A bot is paused right now. You can still read the project write-up; please check back later.

notes.synthetic: All data is synthetic: the company "Sơn Việt Demo Co.", 24 projects, 126 work items.
notes.privacy: Your questions are not stored. The system only records which feature your invite link used, and when. Each question is sent to Google Gemini to produce the answer.

notes.source: Flux generates the image from model and clothing photos provided by the site owner, so you don't upload anything.
notes.flux: The model and item photos you pick are sent to Flux (Black Forest Labs).
notes.privacy: We only record which items and model were picked, and when. The result image is kept for up to an hour so you can download it, then deleted.
